title: guard hook: an agent never records the owner's answer
what: In plugins/delegate/hooks/read-only-guard.py, on PreToolUse Bash with agent_id present: a relay queue note call is allowed only when it is the only command of the call and its --input file already exists and holds no answer key; else deny, naming the next step. Design: Part 4 of the agent-answered-decisions design (queue item a-queue-question-can-be-answered-by-an-agent-mar).
why: relay queue note cannot tell who calls it; today only a few read-only agent types are refused, so a worker could write an owner answer.
